title: Checkpoint: Collections
intro: Test your knowledge of lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets, nested data, and comprehensions.

questions.question: What happens when you run this code?
questions.explanation: {} creates an empty dictionary, not a set, and dictionaries have no add method. Use set() for an empty set.

questions.question: What does this code print?
questions.explanation: [[0] * 3] * 3 repeats the same inner list three times, so changing one row changes them all. Build rows with a comprehension instead.

questions.question: What does this code print?
questions.code: print([n * 2 for n in range(5) if n % 2 == 0])
questions.explanation: The if keeps only the even numbers 0, 2, 4, and each one is doubled.
